newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Jan adj current a/c surplus 21 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: French Jan adj current a/c surplus 21 bln Ffr.

text.p: France's current account showed a seasonally adjusted surplus of 21 billion francs in January, up 10.13 billion francs in December, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
The Ministry said that the seasonally adjusted total in the first one month of 1997 was 21 billion francs, compared with a surplus of 15.16 billion francs in the first one month of 1996.

The Ministry said that the contents and presentation of the balance of payments figures had been changed from the results of December and the full year 1996 due to alterations in methodology which came into effect from January 1997.
